title: District 6 Bulky Item Clean-Up Set for Thursday, Nov. 19 — Items Out Before 6 AM
excerpt: District 6 residents can set out bulky items for the City of Laredo's Fall 2026 Bulky Item Clean-Up on Thursday, Nov. 19. Items must be at the curb before 6 a.m., with streets kept clear for collection crews.
content:
District 6 is next up for the City of Laredo's Fall 2026 Bulky Item Clean-Up, set for Thursday, Nov. 19.

The City of Laredo Solid Waste Services announced the pickup on Thursday, Nov. 13. It is a chance for District 6 households to clear out unwanted bulky items ahead of Thanksgiving.

Residents should place eligible bulky items at the curb before 6 a.m. on pickup day and have everything ready for collection. Streets must be kept clear, with no obstructions blocking the crews.

Residents who are unsure of their council district can look it up by entering their address on the City's map tool at maps.openlaredo.com.

Questions about the clean-up can go to (956) 796-1098 or by calling 311.

Source: City of Laredo Solid Waste Services, Nov. 13, 2026.
